versions.changelog:
- Initial public release of build-docs-creator.
- Generates a standardized, zipped documentation package for developers, including BRD-style product overview, SRS-style requirements, DD-style technical design, interface source code, and reference guide.
- Extracts and reconciles information from project conversation history, artifacts, interfaces, and any externally provided partial documentation.
- Reconciles imported requirements with built design/interface artifacts, explicitly surfacing any gaps or contradictions.
- Adheres to a strict "no invention" policy: only documents what is actually specified or built, placing unresolved details in Open Questions.
- Produces each document following its reference structure for consistency across all generated packages.
